overnightRisk: Four specific things make the next seven and a half hours the riskiest window of the day. ONE - the ETF flow print. Farside's 27 August row has posted at MINUS 41.0m: FBTC (83.6), GBTC (27.2), against BITB +21.7, ARKB +29.7, MSBT +6.7 and BTC +11.7. IBIT, BRRR and HODL are still blank, and IBIT alone supplied 200.8 of yesterday's 232.2, so the number is provisional and can easily flip positive on the late fill. But if it settles negative it ends an eight-session positive streak worth 2,801.9m, and that headline lands in Asian hours with no US desk to absorb it. TWO - the shelf underneath. There is 3,744,961 USD of realized liquidation at 80,250 and another 3,572,447 USD at 80,000, a combined 7.3m sitting 144 and 394 points below spot into the thinnest book of the 24-hour cycle. A flush through 80,250 has a mechanical reason to keep going to 80,000. THREE - momentum decay. The 1H MACD histogram has fallen for seven consecutive bars from 126.25 to 12.87 and is roughly one bar from crossing negative, while the daily RSI is 81.39, the most overbought daily reading of the month. Open interest has also rolled over, down 1.15 percent to 2,233,105,620 USD since midday, so the marginal buyer who drove the afternoon has stopped adding. FOUR - the position itself. The 2x futures long's stop at 79,700.0 is 693.9 points away, which is 1.44 hourly ATRs but only 0.64 of a 4H ATR at 1,092.71 - a single adverse four-hour bar of ordinary size takes it out. That is exactly why the stop stays resting and why half the size comes off tonight: a resting stop is the only protection that works while nobody is watching. There is no scheduled US macro release before the next report at roughly 02:00 COT.

calibration.rollingRecord: Gates over the last thirteen published sessions: FIVE have now fired and confirmed - 26 August morning's REDUCE at 78,246.5, 26 August midday's ADD at 78,621.4, 27 August midnight's ADD at 79,025.8, 27 August morning's ADD at 79,640.7 and now 27 August midday's REDUCE at 80,200.0 - against ten that did not. Every one of the five was written between 0.36 and 0.58 hourly ATRs of spot at publication; every gate written beyond 0.6 ATRs has still gone unused. The two-bar reclaim clause has filtered five false triggers and passed FOUR genuine breaks. Today is the first session of the run in which all four gates of the day resolved: three ADDs fired in sequence and the fourth session's REDUCE fired against them.
calibration.note: Midday's REDUCE gate at a settled 1H close below 80,200.0 FIRED AND CONFIRMED. The 18:00Z bar closed 80,155.2, 44.8 points under the line, and the two-bar reclaim clause was properly tested and failed: 19:00Z closed 79,904.7 and 20:00Z closed 80,097.5, both still under. Its ADD gate at 80,750.0 did NOT fire and was never threatened - the highest print after publication is 80,569.9 and the highest settled close is 80,432.1. But acting_helped is FALSE, and the reason is instructive rather than damning. Price at this endday read is 80,393.9, which is 238.7 points ABOVE the 80,155.2 close that triggered the reduce. A desk that mechanically cut on the trigger is worse off by 0.30 percent. The gate did its job - it flagged real weakness, and price did fall a further 250 points to 79,877.1 before recovering - but the recovery came back through it. This is the FIRST whipsawed gate in the thirteen-session window, and it is worth naming precisely because midday's placement was textbook: 0.51 ATRs out, structural rather than round, with the reclaim clause armed. The transferable finding is that the two-bar reclaim clause is calibrated for TRENDING conditions. It confirmed at 20:00Z, and price reclaimed the level two bars later at 22:00Z. In a 700-point evening box with the hourly ATR CONTRACTING 13.9 percent, two bars is too short a window - the box is wide enough to spend three or four hours on the wrong side of any line drawn through its middle. PROPOSED AMENDMENT for the next session to test: when hourly ATR is contracting and the last six settled closes span less than 1.5 ATRs (tonight: 527.4 points against 481.68, so 1.10 ATRs - it qualifies), extend the reclaim window from two bars to four before treating a gate as confirmed.
